verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's documented instrumentation path is Sentry's open-source SDKs, backed by its Sentry API compatibility claim. Community users confirm the Sentry libraries work reliably with it, including newer reporters like Svelte. The CLI also handles JS source maps and native debug symbols (dSYM, PDB, ELF), which points to frontend and native app coverage. However, GlitchTip ships no first-party SDKs of its own, and the evidence never explicitly confirms per-platform coverage or automatic capture of uncaught errors. Missing for 10: GlitchTip-owned official SDKs, explicit documentation of mobile and backend SDK coverage, explicit evidence of automatic uncaught-error capture.
